name: Red Fort
descriptor: Red sandstone Mughal fortress and palace complex in Old Delhi.

identifyingCues.text: massive red sandstone curtain walls with turrets
large arched entrance gate (Lahori Gate) with bastions
octagonal corner towers along the ramparts

identity.text: Fortified palace built by Shah Jahan when he moved the Mughal capital from Agra to Delhi.

visiting.text: Open daily except Monday, 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM. Sound and light show in the evening.

conditions.text: Flat urban site. Hot summers (May–June above 45 °C) and monsoon rains July–September.

context.text: UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2007. The Prime Minister delivers the Independence Day address from its ramparts each 15 August.
